description: This file defines the CacheScopeManager class, which manages cache contexts and their expiration policies within a caching system. It provides methods to enter and exit cache scopes, add dependencies and contexts, and set expiration times with various strategies.

classes.name: CacheScopeManager
classes.description: Manages cache scopes and their expiration policies, allowing nested cache contexts with methods to set dependencies, contexts, and expiration times.

methods.name: EnterScope
methods.description: Enters a new cache scope by pushing a CacheContext onto the stack.

methods.name: ExitScope
methods.description: Exits the current cache scope by popping the top CacheContext and merging it with the previous one if exists.

methods.name: AddDependencies
methods.description: Adds dependency tags to the current cache scope.

methods.name: AddContexts
methods.description: Adds contexts to the current cache scope.

methods.name: WithExpiryOn
methods.description: Sets an expiry date on the current cache scope, choosing the most restrictive date.

methods.name: WithExpiryAfter
methods.description: Sets an expiry duration after which the cache expires, choosing the most restrictive timespan.

methods.name: WithExpirySliding
methods.description: Sets a sliding expiration timespan for the cache scope.
